messages:
Emma (Partnerships): Quick sync — partner asks for a coordinated go-to-market: Snowflake marketplace + Databricks connector + joint listing with VectorDB partner. Can we map out dependencies and a comms timeline?

Raj (Eng-Platform): Thanks. Do we have a target ship week for the Databricks connector work? I need to know for infra capacity and the deployment plan.

Lisa (Product): Placeholder target is two sprints out (tentatively Wk 3 May). We need eng signoff on schema compatibility and a matrix of supported vector stores.

Miguel (Solutions): From pre-sales calls, customers want: 1) quick setup guide, 2) sample notebooks for Snowflake -> VectorDB -> Redwood flow, 3) a matrix for latency/cost expectations. I can draft notebooks but need dev APIs stable.

Anne (Marketing): We'll need asset checklist for marketplace listing + joint blog + webinar. Also partner requires 2 wk lead for logo approval and quote signoff. Can legal confirm quote language? :eyes:  :calendar: 

Sasha (Legal): We can pre-approve a short quote template. Send proposed language and partner name; we'll fast-track NDAs if needed. No embargoed press mentions before the agreed date.

Raj (Eng-Platform): Quick tech note — Databricks connector needs two things: 1) a streaming path for delta ingestion, 2) connector shim for VectorDB APIs (we support Pinecone, Milvus, and a generic HTTP adapter). If we accept partner's vector DB, we need to add their client and run integration tests.

Emma (Partnerships): Action items (rough):
- Eng: validate connector and schedule internal QA by Apr 28
- Product: finalize supported matrix + sample prompts by Apr 25
- Solutions: sample notebooks + onboarding doc by May 2
- Marketing: draft joint blog outline and webinar date options by Apr 22
- Legal: quote template and partner contract points by Apr 20
Please reply with DRIs.

Miguel (Solutions): DRI for notebooks and onboarding: Miguel. I’ll scaffold a simple notebook today and ping Raj for API hooks.

Raj (Eng-Platform): DRI for connector infra and tests: Raj. I’ll open a tracking ticket and mark required vector DB client versions.

Lisa (Product): DRI for support matrix and prompts: Lisa. I’ll sync with Miguel on the notebook contents to ensure coverage.

Anne (Marketing): DRI for comms and partner assets: Anne. Can we get partner logos and a short partner one-liner by Apr 18? Also want an internal preview deck for sales.

Sasha (Legal): DRI for legal: Sasha. Send the partner name and the quote wording; we’ll return redlines within 48 hours.

Emma (Partnerships): Great. Raj — can you drop the tracking ticket number here when created? Also note partner requested a marketplace promo tile (200x120 svg) + 2 screenshots.

Raj (Eng-Platform): Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-2248 — contains checklist and test matrix. I added a minimal CI job for vector client smoke tests.

Miguel (Solutions): Draft notebook: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/examples/snowflake-databricks-vector-notebook (WIP). Will add README and runbook.

Anne (Marketing): Copy that. Creating event options: May 10 (afternoon PT) or May 17. Which is better for launch alignment?

Emma (Partnerships): Partner prefers May 17. Let's tentatively lock May 17 for webinar, contingent on eng QA pass. :thumbsup:

Raj (Eng-Platform): Noted — aim to finish QA by May 8 to allow a week of bug fixes.

Lisa (Product): I'll schedule a short preread for the sales team on May 12.

Sasha (Legal): Received example quote; returning a redline with minimal edits.

deploy-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing checklist must be completed before release — required fields: description, logos, screenshots, contact email.

Emma (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll assemble a shared project doc and ping the partner with the May 17 provisional date. If anything slips, update the tracker.

Raj (Eng-Platform): Will update INF-2248 with QA results and signal when we have a release candidate.

Miguel (Solutions): I'll post the first notebook draft in the channel once I finish the runbook.

Anne (Marketing): I'll produce the webinar landing page draft and send to partners for approval by Apr 20.

Emma (Partnerships): Closing note: partner asked for co-branded slide deck + a 30s demo clip. Can we capture a short clip during the notebook run?

Miguel (Solutions): Yes — I'll record a quick 30–45s screen capture and upload to the shared drive.

Emma (Partnerships): Awesome. Thanks y'all — please keep updates in INF-2248 and reply here only for high-level syncs. :rocket:
